definition: a good reason for doing something
sentence: There is no {justification} for shouting at a waiter.
translation: Нет никакого оправдания для крика на официанта.

definition: to fall or let fall in small drops
sentence: The tap continues to {drip} all night and keeps me awake.
translation: Кран продолжает капать всю ночь и не даёт мне спать.

definition: to kill someone or something, used in stories or news
sentence: In the legend, the knight must {slay} the dragon to save the town.
translation: В легенде рыцарь должен убить дракона, чтобы спасти город.

definition: to decide not to continue with a plan, at least for now
sentence: The council decided to {shelve} the plan for the new bridge.
translation: Совет решил отложить план нового моста.

definition: to clean something thoroughly, especially skin or a wound
sentence: {Cleanse} the cut with warm water before you cover it.
translation: Промой порез тёплой водой, прежде чем закрыть его.

definition: the child of your son or daughter
sentence: Their first {grandchild} was born on New Year's Day.
translation: Их первый внук родился в Новый год.

definition: the act of making something new again or continuing an agreement
sentence: The {renewal} of my passport took three weeks.
translation: Продление паспорта заняло три недели.

definition: to take something important away from someone
sentence: The war will {deprive} a whole generation of its education.
translation: Война лишит целое поколение образования.

definition: a mass of small bubbles on a liquid, or a soft light material
sentence: The waves left white {foam} along the sand.
translation: Волны оставили белую пену на песке.

definition: a group of sheep, goats or birds
sentence: A {flock} of geese flew south over the lake.
translation: Стая гусей пролетела на юг над озером.

definition: a small bomb thrown by hand
sentence: The soldier pulled the pin and threw the {grenade}.
translation: Солдат выдернул чеку и бросил гранату.

definition: a person who helps an important person in their work
sentence: The senator's {aide} wrote most of the speech.
translation: Помощник сенатора написал большую часть речи.

definition: to make or become broader
sentence: The city plans to {widen} the road to four lanes.
translation: Город планирует расширить дорогу до четырёх полос.

definition: to open again after being closed
sentence: The museum will {reopen} in May after two years of repairs.
translation: Музей снова откроется в мае после двух лет ремонта.

definition: to become or make more serious, worse or more intense
sentence: The argument began to {escalate} when he raised his voice.
translation: Спор начал обостряться, когда он повысил голос.

definition: a woman who belongs to a religious community and lives apart from the world
sentence: The {nun} taught maths at the convent school for forty years.
translation: Монахиня сорок лет преподавала математику в монастырской школе.

definition: public support for someone or something, often from a famous person
sentence: The candidate won the {endorsement} of three major newspapers.
translation: Кандидат получил поддержку трёх крупных газет.

definition: a young unmarried woman, used in old stories
sentence: In the tale, a {maiden} waits in the tower for her rescuer.
translation: В сказке девушка ждёт в башне своего спасителя.

definition: an entrance that can be closed by a gate, or a way to reach something
sentence: The port is the {gateway} to the whole region.
translation: Порт — ворота во весь регион.

definition: to force someone to leave a school, organisation or country
sentence: The school decided to {expel} the boy for bringing a knife.
translation: Школа решила исключить мальчика за то, что он принёс нож.

definition: to control or limit something that is not wanted
sentence: The government is trying to {curb} the rise in rents.
translation: Правительство пытается сдержать рост арендной платы.

definition: to join pieces of metal by heating them until they melt together
sentence: The mechanic will {weld} the broken frame back together.
translation: Механик заварит сломанную раму.

definition: a thin layer of a substance that covers a surface
sentence: The pan has a {coating} that stops food from sticking.
translation: У сковороды покрытие, которое не даёт еде прилипать.

definition: using cruel words or violence towards someone
sentence: She left her {abusive} husband and moved to another city.
translation: Она ушла от жестокого мужа и переехала в другой город.

definition: the area behind a house, often with grass
sentence: The kids are playing football in the {backyard}.
translation: Дети играют в футбол на заднем дворе.

definition: in a way that covers a large area or many things
sentence: She has travelled {extensively} in South America.
translation: Она много путешествовала по Южной Америке.

definition: the part of your face above your eyes and below your hair
sentence: He wiped the sweat from his {forehead} with his sleeve.
translation: Он вытер пот со лба рукавом.

definition: the act of forgiving someone for something they did wrong
sentence: He asked his brother's {forgiveness} for the years of silence.
translation: Он попросил у брата прощения за годы молчания.

definition: in a way that breaks the law
sentence: The car was parked {illegally} outside the hospital entrance.
translation: Машина была незаконно припаркована у входа в больницу.

definition: relaxed and friendly, not following strict rules
sentence: The meeting was {informal}, so nobody wore a suit.
translation: Встреча была неформальной, поэтому никто не надел костюм.

definition: the state of being fully grown or behaving like a sensible adult
sentence: She showed great {maturity} in dealing with the bad news.
translation: Она проявила большую зрелость, столкнувшись с плохими новостями.

definition: expecting good things to happen
sentence: The coach is {optimistic} about the team's chances this season.
translation: Тренер с оптимизмом смотрит на шансы команды в этом сезоне.

definition: full of problems or difficult to deal with
sentence: Getting the piano up the stairs will be {problematic}.
translation: Поднять пианино по лестнице будет проблематично.

definition: intended to advertise a product or event
sentence: The shop gave away {promotional} bags with its name on them.
translation: Магазин раздавал рекламные пакеты со своим названием.

definition: likely to be or become something in the future
sentence: A {prospective} buyer came to look at the house twice.
translation: Потенциальный покупатель дважды приходил смотреть дом.

definition: relating to the treatment of mental illness
sentence: He spent two months in a {psychiatric} hospital after the breakdown.
translation: После нервного срыва он провёл два месяца в психиатрической больнице.

definition: things you throw away because they are no longer wanted, or nonsense
sentence: Put the {rubbish} out on Tuesday night for the morning collection.
translation: Выставь мусор во вторник вечером, чтобы утром его забрали.

definition: a long story about many years or events, or a long series of problems
sentence: The {saga} of the broken lift has gone on for six months.
translation: История со сломанным лифтом тянется уже полгода.

definition: the number 17
sentence: At {seventeen} he left home to work on a ship.
translation: В семнадцать он ушёл из дома работать на корабле.

definition: a soft silver-white metal that forms part of salt
sentence: Too much {sodium} in your food can raise your blood pressure.
translation: Избыток натрия в пище может повысить давление.

definition: done according to a fixed plan or method
sentence: The police made a {systematic} search of every house in the street.
translation: Полиция провела планомерный обыск каждого дома на улице.

definition: too bad to be allowed or agreed to
sentence: Being an hour late for work is {unacceptable}.
translation: Опаздывать на работу на час недопустимо.

definition: not knowing about something
sentence: She was {unaware} that the shop had already closed.
translation: Она не знала, что магазин уже закрылся.

definition: not happening or seen often
sentence: Snow is {uncommon} here, so the city has no snowploughs.
translation: Снег здесь редкость, поэтому в городе нет снегоуборочных машин.

definition: already started and happening
sentence: Work on the new school is {underway} and should finish by June.
translation: Строительство новой школы идёт и должно завершиться к июню.

definition: likely to change, fall or fail suddenly
sentence: The ladder is {unstable}, so ask someone to hold it.
translation: Лестница неустойчивая, попроси кого-нибудь её подержать.

definition: on or to a higher floor of a building
sentence: The bathroom is {upstairs}, the first door on the left.
translation: Ванная наверху, первая дверь слева.

definition: not clear or exact, hard to understand
sentence: He gave a {vague} answer about when he'd be back.
translation: Он уклончиво ответил, когда вернётся.

definition: using careful examination of facts and details to understand something
sentence: Her {analytic} mind made her a good detective.
translation: Её аналитический ум сделал её хорошим детективом.

definition: a short written message from one person to others in an office
sentence: The manager sent a {memo} about the new parking rules.
translation: Менеджер разослал служебную записку о новых правилах парковки.

definition: something you cannot see or remember clearly
sentence: The last hour of the party is a {blur} to me.
translation: Последний час вечеринки я помню смутно.

definition: to shine light on something, or to make it clear and easier to understand
sentence: Candles {illuminate} the church during the evening service.
translation: Свечи освещают церковь во время вечерней службы.

definition: to set a machine or system back to its starting state
sentence: Hold the button for ten seconds to {reset} the router.
translation: Удерживай кнопку десять секунд, чтобы перезагрузить роутер.

definition: a long box in which a dead body is buried or burned
sentence: Six men carried the {coffin} out of the church.
translation: Шестеро мужчин вынесли гроб из церкви.

definition: a person who makes films, especially a director
sentence: The young {filmmaker} shot her first film on a phone.
translation: Молодой режиссёр сняла свой первый фильм на телефон.

definition: a long formal dress, or a loose piece of clothing worn in hospital
sentence: She wore a silk {gown} to the award ceremony.
translation: На церемонию награждения она надела шёлковое платье.

definition: an outdoor area where children can play, often with swings and slides
sentence: The {playground} behind the school has a new climbing frame.
translation: На игровой площадке за школой новая лазалка.

definition: a short phrase that is easy to remember, used in advertising or politics
sentence: The {slogan} on the poster was just three words long.
translation: Лозунг на плакате состоял всего из трёх слов.

definition: a hard swelling on the body, or a solid piece of something
sentence: She found a small {lump} under her arm and saw a doctor.
translation: Она нашла под мышкой небольшое уплотнение и пошла к врачу.

definition: a thick solid piece of something, or a large part
sentence: He cut a big {chunk} of bread and spread butter on it.
translation: Он отрезал большой ломоть хлеба и намазал его маслом.

definition: a person who takes part in a competition
sentence: Each {contestant} has to sing one song of their choice.
translation: Каждый участник должен спеть одну песню по своему выбору.

definition: to fall or jump suddenly downwards, or to fall sharply in value
sentence: Shares will {plunge} if the bank reports another loss.
translation: Акции резко упадут, если банк снова отчитается об убытках.

definition: to talk or shout angrily for a long time about something
sentence: He began to {rant} about the referee as soon as the match ended.
translation: Как только матч закончился, он начал громко ругать судью.

definition: to produce a model or copy of a real situation to test or train
sentence: The software can {simulate} a flight through a storm.
translation: Программа может имитировать полёт сквозь грозу.

definition: to pause before doing something because you are not sure
sentence: I {hesitated} for a second and then pressed 'buy'.
translation: Я секунду поколебался и нажал «купить».

definition: holding an official position at the present time
sentence: The {incumbent} mayor is running for a third term.
translation: Действующий мэр баллотируется на третий срок.

definition: a machine used in the home, such as a fridge or washing machine
sentence: Every {appliance} in the kitchen is less than a year old.
translation: Каждому прибору на кухне меньше года.

definition: a machine that heats water for a house or building
sentence: The {boiler} broke down and we had no hot water for two days.
translation: Котёл сломался, и у нас два дня не было горячей воды.

definition: to take something quickly and roughly, often by force
sentence: A man tried to {snatch} her phone as she left the station.
translation: Мужчина попытался выхватить у неё телефон, когда она выходила с вокзала.

definition: a flat piece of wood, metal or plastic for carrying food and drinks
sentence: The waiter carried six glasses on one {tray}.
translation: Официант нёс шесть бокалов на одном подносе.

definition: a band of metal or other material that you wear around your arm
sentence: She wears a silver {bracelet} that belonged to her mother.
translation: Она носит серебряный браслет, принадлежавший её матери.

definition: a tax on goods brought into a country, or a list of prices
sentence: The new {tariff} on steel will raise the price of cars.
translation: Новая пошлина на сталь поднимет цены на автомобили.

definition: metal as a very thin sheet, used to cover food
sentence: Wrap the fish in {foil} and bake it for twenty minutes.
translation: Заверни рыбу в фольгу и запекай двадцать минут.

definition: to find the right way to go, especially using maps or instruments
sentence: Sailors once used the stars to {navigate} across the ocean.
translation: Когда-то моряки ориентировались по звёздам, пересекая океан.

definition: a small animal with a long bushy tail that climbs trees and eats nuts
sentence: A {squirrel} buried a nut under the oak tree.
translation: Белка закопала орех под дубом.

definition: one of the tubes that carry blood from the heart around the body
sentence: Fat can block an {artery} and cause a heart attack.
translation: Жир может закупорить артерию и вызвать сердечный приступ.

definition: the person who brings a case against someone in a court
sentence: The {plaintiff} claims the company sold her a faulty car.
translation: Истец утверждает, что компания продала ей неисправную машину.

definition: an open area where goods are sold, or the world of buying and selling
sentence: Farmers sell fruit and cheese in the {marketplace} every Saturday.
translation: Фермеры продают фрукты и сыр на рыночной площади каждую субботу.

definition: a small flying insect that bites people and animals and sucks blood
sentence: A {mosquito} kept me awake all night with its buzzing.
translation: Комар всю ночь не давал мне спать своим жужжанием.

definition: a round object on which thread, wire or film is wound
sentence: He wound the fishing line back onto the {reel}.
translation: Он намотал леску обратно на катушку.

definition: easily broken or damaged
sentence: Pack the vase carefully, it's very {fragile}.
translation: Упакуй вазу аккуратно, она очень хрупкая.

definition: a situation that is funny because it is the opposite of what you expected
sentence: The {irony} is that the doctor was the one who got sick.
translation: Ирония в том, что заболел как раз врач.

definition: to rise very quickly to a high level
sentence: Ticket prices {soared} the week before the concert.
translation: За неделю до концерта цены на билеты взлетели.

definition: decided by chance or personal choice, not for a good reason
sentence: The limit of three bags seems completely {arbitrary} to me.
translation: Лимит в три сумки кажется мне совершенно произвольным.

definition: honest and really meaning what you say
sentence: Please accept my {sincere} apologies for the delay.
translation: Пожалуйста, примите мои искренние извинения за задержку.

definition: at a regular speed, without stopping or changing
sentence: Prices have been rising {steadily} all year.
translation: Цены весь год неуклонно растут.

definition: strong bad feelings towards someone, shown in words or actions
sentence: I don't understand the {hostility} between the two neighbours.
translation: Не понимаю, откуда такая вражда между этими соседями.

definition: famous for something bad
sentence: This junction is {notorious} for accidents.
translation: Этот перекрёсток печально известен авариями.

definition: a strong wish to do something you know you should not do
sentence: The {temptation} to check my phone in bed is huge.
translation: Соблазн проверить телефон в кровати огромен.

definition: done on purpose, not by accident
sentence: That was a {deliberate} foul, not an accident.
translation: Это был умышленный фол, а не случайность.

definition: to try very hard to achieve something
sentence: We {strive} to answer every message within a day.
translation: Мы стараемся отвечать на каждое сообщение в течение дня.

definition: to guess about something without knowing all the facts
sentence: Everyone is {speculating} about who will get the job.
translation: Все гадают, кто получит эту должность.

definition: not wanting to do something and slow to agree
sentence: I was {reluctant} to lend him money again.
translation: Мне не хотелось снова одалживать ему деньги.

definition: a situation where you must choose between two difficult options
sentence: I'm in a {dilemma}: a better salary or a shorter commute.
translation: Я перед дилеммой: зарплата выше или дорога короче.

definition: to stay somewhere longer than needed because you do not want to leave
sentence: We {lingered} at the cafe until it closed.
translation: Мы засиделись в кафе до самого закрытия.
